answers.reason: The senate deals with central university strategy, whereas the faculty administrative officer handles faculty examinations and records.
The faculty administrative officer organizes examinations and records rather than central budget allocation.
Selecting candidates for professorships lies outside the faculty administrative officer's responsibility for examinations and records.
Each member participates only in the one body matching their specific matters, which for the faculty administrative officer is the examination board rather than the general faculty council.
The study commission prepares changes to degree programmes, which is distinct from organizing examinations and records.
The faculty administrative officer organizes examinations and student records, which directly matches the examination board's role.
Awarding research grants is unrelated to the faculty administrative officer's duties in examinations and records.
Rewriting module descriptions is a teaching matter outside the faculty administrative officer's examination and record duties.
Choosing laboratory equipment has no connection to organizing examinations, timetables, and records.
Planning the orientation week for new students is separate from the administration of examinations and records.
